name: Google Translate
label: Google Translate
description: Official Cloud Translation API v3 (Advanced) on INPUT input → OUTPUT output. operation: translate, detect, languages. Auth is StudioQuack secret access_token sent as Authorization Bearer (v3 does not accept API keys). Path /v3/projects/{project}:translateText. Docs: https://cloud.google.com/translate/docs/reference/rest/v3/projects/translateText. Terms: https://cloud.google.com/terms. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. translate requires contents + targetLanguageCode. detect uses content. project overrides config. Regional parent: set project to '{id}/locations/{location}'. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"contents":["Hello"],"targetLanguageCode":"es"}.

schema.label: project
schema.description: GCP project id or number for path {project}. Overrides config. For a region use '{project}/locations/{location}'.

schema.label: contents
schema.description: translate body contents[] of UTF-8 strings. Required for translate. Keep under 30 000 codepoints per request.

schema.label: targetLanguageCode
schema.description: translate target ISO-639 code, e.g. es, zh-CN, sr-Latn.

schema.label: sourceLanguageCode
schema.description: Optional source ISO-639. Omit to auto-detect.

schema.label: mimeType
schema.description: text/plain or text/html. Default per API is text/html if omitted.

schema.label: displayLanguageCode
schema.description: languages query: ISO code for language names in the response.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (TranslateTextResponse / DetectLanguageResponse / languages). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official v3 verb. EXACT: translate | detect | languages. Default translate = POST /v3/projects/{project}:translateText.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: OAuth 2.0 access token (scope cloud-translation or cloud-platform). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. v3 does not accept API keys. StudioQuack secret only. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: GCP Project
configurationParameters.description: Default path {project} (project id or number). Override per invoke on INPUT.
